mapper.update: UPDATE identity_menu SET code=#{code},parent_id=#{parentId},name=#{name},menu_type=#{menuType},route_path=#{routePath}, component_key=#{componentKey},permission_id=#{permissionId},icon=#{icon},sort_order=#{sortOrder}, is_visible=#{visible},is_enabled=#{enabled},version=version+1,updated_by=#{updatedBy},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
